android.releaseNotes:
• Redesigned bottom navigation bar to be a floating capsule when transparency effects are on.
• Combined attachment, sticker/GIF, and spoiler buttons in a single fixed-size container to prevent textbox height jitter.
• Added explicit system runtime permission check for push notifications on Android 13+.
